_about: Personal emblems painted on the Juggernaut's armour (lane B4), one entry each; Settings > Gameplay > Juggernaut > Emblem picks one (mech.emblem). An emblem is a one-colour SVG (black on clear) in assets/textures/emblems/, so a new one is one file plus one entry here. colour: linear 0-1 paint colour. size_m: how big it is painted (the cockpit side panel is 0.38 m tall). wear: 0 fresh to 1 nearly gone (chipped by noise). sockets: which mech sockets get it (the socket's forward is the way it faces). face_forward: on the left side the picture is mirrored so it faces the way the mech goes, as squadron markings are.
